steps.detail: add the entry 'beta' and leave every other entry alone
record 'beta' under plus.directEntries.claude-code in the registry
a backup of the client file is made first; the write goes through the client's own lock and conflict check

plan.summary: Give Claude Code a direct entry 'beta' for beta
plan.undo: toolportctl client direct rm srv-beta --client claude-code
warnings: A direct entry bypasses the Toolport gateway: its tools are not covered by access sets, approvals or lazy discovery. Toolport writes no credentials into the client: the client signs in to the server by itself.
